description:
Keeper Commander is a python-based CLI and SDK interface to the Keeper Security platform. Provides administrative controls, reporting, import/export and vault management.

Keeper Commander is a command-line and SDK interface to Keeper® Password Manager. Commander can be used to access and control your Keeper vault, perform administrative functions (such as end-user onboarding and data import/export), launch remote sessions, rotate passwords, eliminate hardcoded passwords and more. Keeper Commander is an open source project with contributions from Keeper's engineering team and partners.
Features
- PAM Cloud Azure credential generation can now authenticate via an interactive Microsoft Entra sign-in (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE over a local loopback redirect), so Azure credentials can be generated without ever passing a password or MFA code through Commander.
- Export and the pam action debug dump command now support Service Mode JSON output, allowing these commands to be driven and consumed programmatically through Service Mode.
Fixes
- Fixed inheritance handling when revoking a parent folder's access on nested share folders: converting an inherited grant into a direct one now adds a new recipient-encrypted folder key instead of updating the inherited row, and explicit denials of inherited access are now tracked so a child folder no longer loses its access state or folder key when the parent grant is revoked.
